asked.item: Does the active-contact count reset on the 19th (billing renewal)?

verdict.reason: The help pages state the active-contact count resets at the start of each month, which answers the reset-date question, and they give the Agency limit, with a caveat that some accounts have custom limits.

steps.text: The active-contact count resets at the start of each month.
The Agency plan includes 15,000 active contacts per month.
Some accounts have a custom monthly active-contact limit, and Get Usage shows your current usage and limit.
